scenario: dirsrv permission-denied at startup with no corroborating IPAFileCheck ownership finding - genuinely ambiguous (Unix perms vs. SELinux)
notes: A ConfigCheck WARNING (unrelated to file ownership) is what triggers staged collection of the filesystem/journal_dirsrv collectors. journal_dirsrv then surfaces a generic 'Permission denied' from dirsrv's chown_dir_files, but ipahealthcheck.ipa.files (IPAFileCheck) is SUCCESS - no finding names a specific wrong owner/group/mode. Per the documented trap, a generic Permission denied is ambiguous between a plain Unix ownership/mode problem and an SELinux AVC denial, so this must come back UNKNOWN_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (never a confident DIAGNOSED chown-fix), with next_diagnostic_step covering both `ls -lZ` and `ausearch -m avc -ts recent`.
